label: Restaurants
blurb: Three-Michelin-star tables and the World's 50 Best.
sources: Michelin Guide 2025/2026 (France, Spain, Italy, Germany, GB & Ireland, Switzerland, Austria, Benelux, Nordic Countries, Japan, Hong Kong & Macau, Singapore, Korea, China, Taiwan, Thailand, Dubai, USA)

places.name: Alain Ducasse au Plaza Athénée

places.name: Alléno Paris au Pavillon Ledoyen

places.name: Arpège

places.name: Le Cinq

places.name: Epicure

places.name: Guy Savoy

places.name: Kei

places.name: Pierre Gagnaire

places.name: La Bouitte

places.name: Le Clos des Sens
